watch.anchor: "Travel Only" Day: For any day of the week (including holidays) on which an employee travels only

terms.notes: Sec. 27 also carries Part A Sec. 7(c) travel time over to Part B.

value.observance: Sunday -> following Monday; Saturday -> preceding Friday, except Saturday stays Saturday in six-day workweeks
value.worked: 2x (Sec. 30(c)); see ot_ladder.7th_holiday

daily.eligibility: works the scheduled workday before and after (no pay if the next workday follows a hiatus of a week or more)

not_worked.exceptions: none for long-form TV, mini-series, pilots, first season of one-hour or basic cable / CW series; 4 hrs in the second basic cable / CW season

watch.anchor: The following days shall be recognized as holidays for employees employed under the provisions of Part B of this Agreement

terms.notes: Non-accrual (J5), unlike Part A (4.583% lump sum). Good Friday is a Part B holiday; Veterans' Day is not.

value.fund: IATSE National Benefit Funds (pension, health and welfare, annuity)
value.exception: Hired in New York, or in New Jersey within 65 mi of Columbus Circle: MPI Pension, Health and Individual Account Plans per Part A Sec. 12 (Sec. 31(b))

watch.anchor: The Employer shall make pension, welfare and annuity contributions on behalf of employees covered under Part B of this Agreement

terms.notes: Per day worked, not per hour. No fringe global yet: fringe canon item.

value.local: principal residence within 60 mi of the production location
value.nearby: outside 60 mi but inside the Local 52 jurisdiction: weekly living allowance
value.distant: outside the Nearby definition: reasonable single-occupancy hotel, per diem

watch.anchor: A Local Hire is defined as any employee whose principal residence is within sixty (60) miles of the respective production location.

terms.notes: Provided meals may be deducted from per diem at the stated rates (33(e)(2)).

rules: Contract text governs; MOA summaries yield to contract text.

Where a local's base agreement is not available (West Coast 695, 705, 706, 729; 700, 871 and 884 2018 texts; Local 800 STG 2024 MOA), use the IATSE (Hollywood) Basic Agreement + the 2024 general and local MOAs + current wage scales/rate sheets as the only resource.
CWA: the full 2024 MOA is not available; use the 2024-2028 PPA/PC highlights summary.
Every contract is recorded in this index; TermsWatch checks the watch_sources URLs weekly and flags changes for a re-harvest.

EP Paymaster is a bridge, not a source of record. Where a unit's own contract text is unavailable, fill blanks from the Hollywood Basic Agreement alongside the latest Paymaster (status PAYMASTER, edition and page cited). The Paymaster is also a signal: when a new Paymaster edition shows a new agreement for a union, fetch that agreement from its publisher, harvest from it, and retire the PAYMASTER rows for that union. The bridge rule ends union by union as new contracts are published.

Published rate cards are canon even when the publisher's filename says DRAFT, once checked against an independent source (e.g. ICG Eastern 2026-27 V03 vs Paymaster 2026-27). The watcher picks up any re-post.

schema_notes.inherits: An agreement may list `inherits: [agreement_id]` and `wcsl_local_key`. resolveTerms returns the agreement's own rows plus the inherited agreement's rows whose applies.locals includes wcsl_local_key (or has no locals key) and whose applies.locals_excluded does not. Own rows beat inherited rows of the same topic and day_class.
schema_notes.footprint:
states    {USPS: coverage}. coverage: "full" (whole state), "partial" (part of the state,
            named in `areas`; price the agreement and say where it stops), "named_area" (only a
            small named area of the state; treat a base there as outside unless the location is
            in the area).
  areas     plain-language areas, verbatim from the clause.
  except    carve-outs.
  outside   what the agreement says happens outside the footprint:
            kind "agreement_applies" | "negotiated" | "pension_health_only" | "other_agreement".
  sub       footprints for named classifications that differ from the agreement's own.
  rate_bands  sub-areas that pick a different wage table inside the footprint.
  watch     anchor + clause_hash (hash_method of the file) for TermsWatch.
